notes: The tutorial floor's lines (TUT-P1 beats 1-11, from TUT-C1 with the TUT-C1b edits), played once by a brand-new profile. Rooms: Tower Path (path, stones, bow), Training Hall (dummies, STRIKE, Swarmers), First Steps Hall (Brute, Dash), vault (Insight, chest), Keep (boss, door). One line per step; 'success' shows when the step is done. advance 'tap' = Got it finishes it; 'move' = after Got it the game waits for waitFor. On the brute step the screen line is the tip (the Brute waits until Got it), then the guided Counter lines from first-session-lessons.json teach the try. tutorial-stones: 'retry' is the stumble line and 'help' shows with the slower retry and its pointer. The story cards and the closing line are in tutorial-story.json. Every kid line is 8 words or fewer (checked by the tutorial tests). No timers: every tip waits for a Got it tap.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: Tower Path: the hero follows Sensei to the Tower door
screens: Tap to walk, or use the stick.
lessons.success: Good steps! Stay close to me.

lessons.trigger: The Tower rumbles; stones fall, a red circle shows first (3 waves)
screens: Red circle on the ground? Step out!
lessons.retry: Oops! Dust off. The stones come again.
lessons.help: Watch the red. Step where I point.

screens: Bow at the door to show respect.
Walk close. You strike on your own!

lessons.trigger: Big dummy; Focus is full and STRIKE glows
screens: Focus is full! Tap the glowing STRIKE!
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the glowing STRIKE button!

lessons.trigger: 2 Swarmers slip out of a crack
screens: Shadows! Walk close, just like the dummies.
lessons.retry: That's okay. The Swarmers will come back.

lessons.trigger: First Steps Hall: a slow Brute winds up (guided Counter)
screens: Red circle again! This time, tap COUNTER!
lessons.retry: Almost! The circle will come again.
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the glowing COUNTER button!

lessons.trigger: Swarmers from two sides; DASH glows
screens: Crowded? DASH out to open space.
lessons.success: Nice DASH! Lots of room now.
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the glowing DASH button!

screens: Here is an Insight for you!
lessons.success: It will help you until you go home.

screens: A treasure chest! Walk up to open it.

lessons.trigger: Keep: the easy Floor Keeper; Sensei says one line, then stays quiet
screens: A big one! Use everything you learned.

lessons.trigger: Keep: the door home opens (no light piece)
